## Questions
### Where is Aylesbury Health and Wellness?
We are at The Old Chapel, 185b Aylesbury Road, Bierton, Aylesbury, Buckinghamshire, HP22 5DW. Free parking is available on site. The clinic is a short drive from Aylesbury town centre.

### Which areas do you serve?
The clinic is in Bierton and welcomes patients from Aylesbury, Stoke Mandeville, Wendover, Aston Clinton, Wing, Stone, Buckingham, Leighton Buzzard, Tring and the surrounding Buckinghamshire villages.

### Do you offer colonic hydrotherapy in Aylesbury?
Yes. Colonic hydrotherapy is available at our Bierton clinic, including single sessions, courses of six, and combinations with massage. Appointments start from £90. Book online via Fresha.

### Do you provide diabetic footcare near Aylesbury?
Yes. Professional footcare is carried out by a qualified Foot Health Practitioner and specialises in diabetic footcare, including nail cutting, callus, corns, verrucas and fungal nails. This is clinical footcare, not a cosmetic pedicure. Prices start from £45.

### Can I get ear microsuction in Aylesbury?
Yes. We offer ear consultations, bilateral microsuction and irrigation for wax removal at The Old Chapel in Bierton. Ear care starts from £20.

### What are your opening hours?
Monday to Thursday 09:00–19:00, Friday and Saturday 09:00–20:00, Sunday 10:00–17:00.

### How do I book an appointment?
Book online through Fresha, call 07379 987766 or 01296 926045, email info@aylesburyhealthandwellness.co.uk, or message us on WhatsApp.
